milestone: M1 — Service skeleton & HTTP/CLI contract scaffolding
title: Stand up svg-gen service skeleton with /health, stub /render, and CLI entry points
body:
## Context

First working slice of the `svg-gen` service. After this issue lands, operators can boot the process via the CLI, container probes see a healthy service, and HTTP callers receive a typed `NotImplemented` envelope from `/render` while later milestones wire up the real pipeline. The Pydantic models for the constraint-graph scene format and the HTTP request/response envelopes land here so every downstream issue builds on a shared, typed contract.

## What this ships

- A FastAPI app exposing:
  - `GET /health` returning HTTP 200 with body `{"status": "ok"}` and no authentication.
  - `POST /render` accepting a JSON body, validating it against the `SceneV1` Pydantic envelope (constraint-graph form: points + relations + label slots; no raw coordinate fields), and returning a typed `501 NotImplemented` response while the render pipeline is not yet implemented.
- A `svg-gen` CLI with two subcommands:
  - `svg-gen serve [--host 0.0.0.0] [--port 8001]` — boots the FastAPI app.
  - `svg-gen render <scene-file> [--output <path>]` — parses and validates the scene file, prints a typed `NotImplemented` message to stderr, and exits non-zero (replaced with a working render in a later issue).
- JSON-line logging to stdout.
- A container image that does not include the Playwright/Chromium package.

## Pydantic model surface delivered

- `SceneV1` envelope plus the constraint-graph component payload base classes (points, the eight constraint kinds — `distance`, `angle`, `rightAngle`, `parallel`, `perpendicular`, `midpoint`, `onLine`, `congruent` — and label-slot descriptors).
- The error envelope `{"detail": {"error": "<discriminator>", "message": "<text>", "details": {...}}}` used by every HTTP failure response throughout the service. Discriminators reserved at this point: `InvalidScene` (400), `NotImplemented` (501), `InternalError` (500).
- Pydantic schemas reject any field shaped like a coordinate (`x`, `y`, `coordinates`, `vertices: [[number, number], …]`) — coordinate inputs cause a 400 InvalidScene.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `svg-gen serve` on a fresh container responds 200 to `GET /health` within 5 s of process start.
- [ ] `GET /health` returns body equal to `{"status": "ok"}` byte-for-byte; latency p95 < 50 ms on a warm process.
- [ ] `POST /render` with a syntactically valid `SceneV1` body returns HTTP 501 with body `{"detail": {"error": "NotImplemented", "message": "<text>", "details": {}}}`.
- [ ] `POST /render` with malformed JSON or schema violation returns HTTP 400 with body `{"detail": {"error": "InvalidScene", "message": "Scene validation failed", "details": [<pydantic errors>]}}`.
- [ ] A request body containing a raw coordinate-shaped field is rejected at schema time as 400 InvalidScene (not as a downstream error).
- [ ] `svg-gen render <bad-file>` exits with code 2 and writes a human-readable error to stderr.
- [ ] `svg-gen render <valid-file>` exits non-zero (until later issues implement rendering) and writes a typed `NotImplemented` message to stderr.
- [ ] `svg-gen serve` exits non-zero with a clear error when the requested port is already bound.
- [ ] `svg-gen serve` shuts down cleanly within 10 s of SIGTERM; no in-flight request is corrupted.
- [ ] The runtime container image does not include the `playwright` package (verified by `pip list` in CI).
- [ ] No authentication is required for any endpoint; any caller that can reach the bound port can call it.
- [ ] Logs are emitted as JSON lines to stdout.

title: Deterministic constraint solver library and `svg-gen solve` CLI
body:
## Context

Delivers the geometric core of the deterministic pipeline. The `ConstraintSolver` turns a validated constraint-graph scene into `SolvedGeometry` (every point given exact coordinates, every length and angle exact) without consulting any LLM. After this issue lands, developers can pipe any constraint-graph scene through `svg-gen solve` and inspect the resolved geometry, which makes every downstream issue (layout, rendering, planner eval) debuggable in isolation.

## What this ships

- `ConstraintSolver` implementing residual functions for the eight constraint kinds (`distance`, `angle`, `rightAngle`, `parallel`, `perpendicular`, `midpoint`, `onLine`, `congruent`) and a Newton solver over the resulting Jacobian.
- `SolvedGeometry` Pydantic model carrying exact coordinates per point, exact length per segment, exact angle per declared angle.
- `UnsatisfiableConstraintsError` carrying the minimal infeasible subset of constraints.
- A typed convergence error for the case where Newton iteration exceeds the cap.
- A fixed deterministic initial layout (points placed evenly around the unit circle) and a fixed seed so under-determined systems (infinite solutions) resolve to one canonical solution.
- New CLI subcommand `svg-gen solve <scene-file> [--output <path>]` that prints `SolvedGeometry` JSON to stdout (or the output path) on success, prints the typed error JSON to stderr and exits non-zero on infeasibility / non-convergence.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `svg-gen solve` returns bit-identical `SolvedGeometry` JSON across two consecutive runs on the same input file.
- [ ] On the project's `tests/fixtures/solver/` set of known-feasible scenes the solver converges within 200 Newton iterations for 100% of fixtures.
- [ ] Every right angle in solver output is 90° within tolerance 1e-6; every declared midpoint is the exact midpoint within the same tolerance — verified by automated tests over the fixture set.
- [ ] On every fixture in `tests/fixtures/solver-infeasible/`, the solver raises `UnsatisfiableConstraintsError` and the CLI exits non-zero with a stderr message including the minimal infeasible subset.
- [ ] On every fixture in `tests/fixtures/solver-underdetermined/`, the solver returns a `SolvedGeometry` that is byte-identical across runs (canonical-solution determinism).
- [ ] On every fixture in `tests/fixtures/solver-divergent/`, the solver raises the typed convergence error and the CLI exits non-zero.
- [ ] The solver module does not import any LLM client (static guard test in CI fails the build if it does).
- [ ] `svg-gen solve <bad-file>` exits with code 2 and a stderr message naming the Pydantic validation failure.

milestone: M3 — Layout optimizer, math-trim, and verify-bbox
title: Global label/angle-mark layout optimizer, math-based viewBox trim, and --verify-bbox CLI
body:
## Context

Builds the placement and bounds layer on top of the solver. The layout optimizer places every label and every angle mark in one global pass over `SolvedGeometry`, minimising a cost function whose consistency term keeps all side-labels in a scene at a similar distance from their line. The math-based viewBox trim closes the bounds over the union of geometry and label boxes plus padding, with no browser involvement at runtime. The `--verify-bbox` dev tool is the single sanctioned place where Chromium runs — for CI verification of the math-bbox computation against a real browser.

After this issue lands, the placement/bounds outputs can be inspected directly via the CLI, and the `--verify-bbox` job is wired into CI ready for renderer fixtures in the next issue.

## What this ships

- `LayoutOptimizer` consuming `SolvedGeometry` + declared label/angle-mark slots + renderer-supplied text bbox estimates and producing `LayoutResult` placing each label and angle mark with absolute coordinates and orientations.
- Cost function: `w1·overlap(label,geometry) + w2·overlap(label,label) + w3·distance-from-preferred + w4·label-distance-inconsistency` with documented default weights, fixed seed, and a fixed gradient/anneal schedule.
- `LayoutInfeasibleError` typed error for cases where no placement satisfies hard constraints.
- `MathBoxTrim` computing the final viewBox as `BBox.union(all geometry bboxes ∪ all label bboxes) + padding` with defaults: outer `SVG_TRIM_PADDING = 14.0` applied symmetrically; container-layout constants `LABEL_SLOT_PADDING = 5.0`, `TOP_ALIGNED_BOTTOM_PADDING = 10.0`, container `_TOP_PADDING = _SIDE_PADDING = 20.0`. No HTTP/CLI parameter overrides these.
- New CLI subcommands:
  - `svg-gen layout <scene-file>` — prints `LayoutResult` JSON.
  - `svg-gen render <scene-file> --verify-bbox [--bbox-tolerance 1.0]` — flag is accepted by the CLI; the verifier launches Chromium, computes the browser bbox for an SVG composed of the layout-placed boxes, diffs against the math-bbox, prints per-element deltas, exits 0 if all within tolerance and 1 otherwise.
- A static guard test asserting that no module reachable from `/render` or `/image/fromQuestion` imports `playwright`.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `svg-gen layout` produces byte-identical `LayoutResult` JSON across two consecutive runs on the same input.
- [ ] On every fixture in `tests/fixtures/layout/`, the optimizer produces a placement with zero label-label overlap and zero label-vs-geometry overlap, verified by automated geometric checks.
- [ ] On every fixture in `tests/fixtures/layout-infeasible/`, the optimizer raises `LayoutInfeasibleError`, naming the labels that could not be placed.
- [ ] For every scene with multiple side-labels, the optimizer's `w4` term keeps the max per-label deviation from the mean line-distance to ≤ 25% (asserted in the fixture-driven test).
- [ ] The math-bbox viewBox for a given fixture is byte-identical across two consecutive runs.
- [ ] `svg-gen render --verify-bbox` exits 0 on the `tests/fixtures/bbox/` set with default tolerance 1.0 px per element.
- [ ] `svg-gen render --verify-bbox` exits 3 with a clear `playwright install chromium` instruction when Chromium is not installed locally.
- [ ] The static guard test fails CI if any runtime path imports `playwright`.
- [ ] The `playwright` package remains absent from the runtime container image.

milestone: M4 — v0 renderer set + deterministic test suite
title: v0 renderer set (Rectangle, Triangle, CoordinatePlane) and deterministic geometric test suite
body:
## Context

First issue that turns `POST /render` and `svg-gen render` into working user-visible endpoints. Implements the constraint-graph renderer contract (`declare_constraints`, `draw`, `label_candidates`) and ships the three v0 component renderers — `rectangle`, `triangle`, `coordinatePlane` — wired end-to-end through solver → optimizer → trim → SVG emission. Also ships the deterministic geometric test suite that turns the recurring visual bug classes into automated CI gates.

After this issue lands, any caller can POST a v0-supported constraint-graph scene to `/render` and receive a valid SVG that passes overlap/clipping/angle-mark/label-collision/consistency checks.

## What this ships

- `ComponentRenderer` abstract base with `declare_constraints(c) -> list[Constraint]`, `draw(solved, c, ctx) -> str`, and `label_candidates(solved, c) -> list[LabelCandidate]`. Renderer modules contain no geometry computation (static check: no `math` import beyond an approved helper list).
- Renderers for `rectangle`, `triangle`, `coordinatePlane`. Triangle includes angle-mark slots; CoordinatePlane includes axis ticks, gridlines, and plotted points/lines.
- Wiring: `POST /render` and `svg-gen render <scene-file>` now run the full pipeline (validate → solve → layout → render → trim) and return `Content-Type: image/svg+xml` with the SVG bytes (HTTP) or write the SVG to stdout / `--output` (CLI).
- Error envelope discriminators activated: `UnknownComponent` (500), `SVGGenerationFailed` (500). `UnsatisfiableConstraintsError`, `LayoutInfeasibleError`, and Newton convergence failure all map to `500 SVGGenerationFailed` with the underlying message in `details`.
- Deterministic geometric test suite covering the five bug classes:
  1. element-overlap
  2. clipping outside viewBox
  3. mis-aligned angle marks (up/down side of vertex)
  4. label-line collisions
  5. label-distance inconsistency (max deviation ≤ 25% of mean per scene)
- Test fixtures: one positive (passing) and one negative (intentionally broken; suite must fail) scene per bug class.
- `--verify-bbox` CI job from issue 3 is now run against the M4 fixture set on every PR and required-green to merge.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `POST /render` returns HTTP 200 with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml` for every fixture in `tests/fixtures/scenes/{rectangle,triangle,coordinate-plane}/`.
- [ ] Every returned SVG passes all five checks in the deterministic geometric test suite — no element overlap, nothing clipped outside viewBox, every angle mark on the correct side of its vertex, no label-line collisions, label-distance inconsistency ≤ 25%.
- [ ] `POST /render` with a scene whose top-level component is not in the v0 set returns HTTP 500 with body `{"detail": {"error": "UnknownComponent", "message": "Component type not supported", "details": {"component_type": "<name>"}}}`.
- [ ] `POST /render` with constraints the solver finds unsatisfiable returns HTTP 500 with `error: "SVGGenerationFailed"` and the solver's minimal-infeasible-subset text in `message`.
- [ ] `POST /render` with a scene whose labels cannot be placed returns HTTP 500 with `error: "SVGGenerationFailed"` and the layout-infeasible text in `message`.
- [ ] Two `POST /render` calls with the same body produce byte-identical SVG responses.
- [ ] `svg-gen render <scene-file>` for every v0 fixture exits 0 and writes a valid SVG.
- [ ] The deterministic test suite runs under 30 s on a CI runner over the M4 fixture set.
- [ ] For each of the five bug classes, the negative fixture causes the test suite to fail (asserted by a meta-test).
- [ ] `svg-gen render --verify-bbox` exits 0 on every v0 fixture with default tolerance 1.0 px.
- [ ] Adding a hypothetical fourth component type requires touching only the new renderer module and a single registry entry (asserted by a code-organisation test: registry diff size = 1 line).
- [ ] No renderer module imports `math` outside the approved helper list (static check).
- [ ] p95 latency of `POST /render` over the v0 fixture set is < 1000 ms on a warm container.
- [ ] The runtime container image still does not include `playwright`.

title: 30-scene LLM constraint-emission eval gate and recorded path decision
body:
## Context

Gate that decides whether issue 6 ships the primary constraint-graph planner or the anchor-model contingency. Runs a curated 30-scene eval that exercises the LLM's ability to emit Pydantic-valid constraint-graph scenes that the deterministic pipeline (already shipped) successfully renders. The artifact is committed and the path choice is recorded before any planner code is written.

## What this ships

- An eval harness `svg-gen eval 30-scene --provider <id> --model <id> --seed <n> --output <path>` that:
  - Loads a curated 30-scene fixture set from `.rebaseai/plan/eval/30-scene-inputs.json`.
  - For each scene, runs the candidate LLM once with the production planner prompt and the constraint-graph output schema.
  - For each emission, runs the full deterministic pipeline (validate → solve → layout → render → test suite) and records pass/fail.
  - Emits a JSON artifact with provider id, model id, prompt hash, seed, snapshot date, per-scene input + emission + pass/fail, aggregate first-try success rate, and the threshold (0.85).
- The 30-scene curated input set, sampled from the upstream question source's recent traffic such that each v0 component type contributes ≥ 5 scenes and the remaining slots cover at least 5 distinct launch-parity component types. Sampling seed and snapshot timestamp are recorded inside the inputs file.
- A recorded path-choice file committed alongside the artifact at `.rebaseai/plan/eval/path-choice.md` naming `primary` or `contingency` and the tech-lead sign-off.

## Success definition per scene (all four required)

1. Feasibility check (stubbed for this issue — issue 6 implements the real one; this issue runs the eval against the planner alone, treating every input as feasible by construction since inputs are pre-curated) does not block the scene.
2. Planner emits a Pydantic-validating constraint-graph scene on the first attempt.
3. The solver converges on that scene.
4. The rendered SVG passes the deterministic test suite end-to-end.

## Threshold

- ≥ 85% first-try success → record `primary` path. Issue 6 ships the constraint-graph planner.
- < 85% → record `contingency` path. Issue 6 ships the Proposal 2 anchor-model planner; M2–M4 deliverables are reused unchanged.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `svg-gen eval 30-scene` reruns produce an identical pass/fail table given the same provider, model, seed, prompt, and inputs file.
- [ ] The committed artifact at `.rebaseai/plan/eval/30-scene-<date>.json` contains every field listed under "What this ships".
- [ ] The artifact's input set has ≥ 5 scenes per v0 component type and covers ≥ 5 additional launch-parity component types.
- [ ] If the LLM provider is unreachable or quota-exhausted mid-run, the harness exits non-zero and does not commit a partial artifact.
- [ ] `.rebaseai/plan/eval/path-choice.md` names exactly one of `primary` or `contingency`, references the artifact filename, and carries the tech-lead sign-off.
- [ ] No file outside `.rebaseai/plan/eval/` is modified by this issue.

milestone: M6 — LLM planner & feasibility, plus question entry point
title: LLM feasibility check, constraint-graph planner (or anchor-model contingency), and /image/fromQuestion endpoint
body:
## Context

Turns the service into something an upstream pipeline can call directly with a math question. Wires the LLM feasibility check on the front, the planner (primary constraint-graph planner if `.rebaseai/plan/eval/path-choice.md` records `primary`; anchor-model contingency planner if it records `contingency`) in the middle, and the already-shipped deterministic pipeline at the back, exposed over `POST /image/fromQuestion`.

After this issue lands, callers can POST a question payload and receive an SVG diagram, with typed error envelopes for every failure mode.

## What this ships

- `POST /image/fromQuestion` accepting an `ImageFromQuestionRequest` JSON body and returning `200 image/svg+xml` on success; sets the `X-Duration-Ms` response header (total wall-clock processing time in milliseconds) on every response.
- LLM feasibility check invoked first on every `/image/fromQuestion` request:
  - Feasible → reasoning string passed to the planner.
  - Not feasible (including borderline / model unsure cases — fail-closed) → HTTP **400** with body `{"detail": {"error": "UnsupportedRequest", "message": "Request is not supported by the deterministic SVG renderer. Fallback image generation is disabled.", "details": {"feasibility_reasoning": "<LLM free text>"}}}`.
  - LLM call error / timeout → HTTP **500** `FeasibilityCheckFailed` with provider text in `message`.
- LLM planner (primary or contingency per the recorded path-choice file) emitting a Pydantic-validating constraint-graph scene; on validation failure or solver `UnsatisfiableConstraintsError`, the typed error payload is fed back as retry feedback. **Retry budget: 3 total attempts (initial + 2 retries).** Per-LLM-call timeout 10000 ms.
- Failure mapping for `/image/fromQuestion`:
  - Planner exhausts 3 attempts → HTTP **500** `SVGGenerationFailed`, `message: "Generated scene failed validation after 3 attempts"`.
  - Solver/optimizer fail at runtime → HTTP **500** `SVGGenerationFailed`, message from the underlying exception.
  - Unknown component → HTTP **500** `UnknownComponent`.
  - Reserved `NotImplemented` agent-error type → HTTP **501** `NotImplemented`.
  - Any other unhandled exception → HTTP **500** `InternalError`.
  - Never returns an empty SVG, a `{"image": null}` sentinel, or a placeholder image.
- Static guard test asserting that the LLM client is imported only by the feasibility module and the planner module.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `POST /image/fromQuestion` returns HTTP 200 with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml` for every question in `.rebaseai/plan/eval/30-scene-<date>.json` that the recorded artifact marked successful, and the SVG passes the deterministic geometric test suite.
- [ ] `X-Duration-Ms` is set on 100% of responses (success and failure).
- [ ] For every fixture in `tests/fixtures/unsupported_questions/`, the response is HTTP 400 with `detail.error == "UnsupportedRequest"` and `details.feasibility_reasoning` containing the LLM's free-text explanation.
- [ ] When the feasibility LLM call times out (10000 ms cap) the response is HTTP 500 with `detail.error == "FeasibilityCheckFailed"`.
- [ ] When the planner exhausts 3 attempts on a fixture in `tests/fixtures/unsatisfiable_questions/`, the response is HTTP 500 with `detail.error == "SVGGenerationFailed"` and the message text `"Generated scene failed validation after 3 attempts"`.
- [ ] Planner retry count is logged for every call and never exceeds 3.
- [ ] The error response envelope shape (`{"detail": {"error": ..., "message": ..., "details": ...}}`) is identical across all 4xx and 5xx cases, so callers can branch on `detail.error` alone.
- [ ] No success path ever returns an empty SVG or a JSON sentinel; the only success body is real SVG bytes with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml`.
- [ ] Static guard test fails CI if any module other than the feasibility and planner modules imports the LLM client.
- [ ] If `.rebaseai/plan/eval/path-choice.md` records `primary`, the constraint-graph planner is shipped and ≥ 85% of the 30-scene set succeeds on first attempt in CI re-run.
- [ ] If `.rebaseai/plan/eval/path-choice.md` records `contingency`, the anchor-model planner is shipped instead; the solver, optimizer, renderers, trim, and test suite from issues 2–4 are reused unchanged (verified by git diff scope being limited to the planner module and prompt assets).
- [ ] p95 latency of `POST /image/fromQuestion` on the eval set < 30000 ms on a warm container.
- [ ] No authentication is required on `/image/fromQuestion`.

milestone: M7 — Component coverage expansion to launch parity
title: Port remaining component types to the constraint-graph renderer contract for launch parity
body:
## Context

Final coverage milestone. Ports every remaining launch-parity component type to the constraint-graph renderer contract so `UnknownComponent` is never returned for any name in the launch-parity list. After this issue lands, callers can request the full set of supported diagram types through both `POST /render` (constraint-graph scenes) and `POST /image/fromQuestion` (question payloads that the planner translates).

## Launch-parity component scope (must work at end of this issue)

- **Polygons / closed shapes**: `rectangle`, `square`, `triangle`, `circle`, `point`, `parallelogram`, `trapezoid`, `rhombus`, `kite`, `pentagon`, `concavePentagon`, `hexagon`, `heptagon`, `octagon`, `nonagon`, `decagon`, `starPolygon`, `quadrilateral`, `partitionedShape`.
- **Angles & clocks**: `angleDiagram`, `directedAngleDiagram`, `directedAngleDiagramTicks`, `clock`, `digitalClock`.
- **Measurement & manipulatives**: `numberLine`, `faultyNumberLine`, `ruler`, `alignedLengthComparison`, `protractor`, `array`, `tree`, `counterChange`, `gridRectangle`, `gridSquare`, `multiplicationAreaModel`, `rectilinearShape`, `coordinatePlane`, `symmetryFigure`.
- **Charts, tables, 3D, nets**: `table`, `data_table`, `two_row_table`, `barGraph`, `histogram`, `pictureGraph`, `linePlot`, `faultyLinePlot`, `faultyCircleGraph`, `boxWhiskerPlot`, `lineRelationshipDiagram`, `placeValueBlocks`, `longPlaceValueArithmetic`, `longDivision`, `isometricPrism`, `isometricSolid`, `triangularPrism`, `vennDiagram`, `cubeNet`, `rectangularPrismNet`, `triangularPrismNet`, `rectangularPyramidNet`.

The three v0 names (`rectangle`, `triangle`, `coordinatePlane`) already work from issue 4; this issue ports the remainder.

## What this ships

- A renderer module per remaining component type, each implementing `declare_constraints`, `draw`, and `label_candidates`, containing no geometry computation (only reading `SolvedGeometry`).
- One canonical scene fixture per component type in `tests/fixtures/scenes/<component-type>/canonical.json` that renders cleanly through the full pipeline.
- Extension of the planner prompt and (if needed) the feasibility prompt so `/image/fromQuestion` produces these component types when the question requires them.
- Final removal of the temporary `UnknownComponent` stub for the listed names from the router (it still applies for any name *outside* the list).
- Final confirmation that the `playwright` package is absent from the runtime container image (the `--verify-bbox` dev tool is unaffected).

## Definition of Done

- [ ] For every component name in the launch-parity list, `POST /render` returns HTTP 200 with `image/svg+xml` for the canonical fixture in `tests/fixtures/scenes/<component-type>/canonical.json`, and the returned SVG passes the deterministic geometric test suite.
- [ ] For every component name in the launch-parity list, `svg-gen render` on its canonical fixture exits 0 and produces a test-suite-clean SVG.
- [ ] For every component name in the launch-parity list, `svg-gen render --verify-bbox` on its canonical fixture exits 0 within the default 1.0 px tolerance.
- [ ] `POST /render` returns HTTP 500 `UnknownComponent` for any component name **not** in the launch-parity list (e.g. an invented `octahedron`).
- [ ] `POST /image/fromQuestion` returns HTTP 200 with `image/svg+xml` for at least one curated question per component name in the launch-parity list, and the returned SVG passes the deterministic geometric test suite.
- [ ] Every renderer module passes the no-geometry-computation static check (no `math` import beyond the approved helper list).
- [ ] The runtime container image still does not include `playwright`.
- [ ] Two `POST /render` calls with the same body still produce byte-identical SVG responses for every launch-parity component.
